rows.Origin: Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in 1996 as 'Sakuragai'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. Mild fragrance. up to 20 petals. Average diameter 2.5". Medium, double (17-25 petals), in small clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Few or no prickles/thorns, upright.

Height: up to 47" (up to 120cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Source: Website Keisei Rose Nurseries.
